spec.name: brand2-email-reporting
spec.stack: operational — no build. Claude engine + Klaviyo read-only Reporting/Metrics API. No app, no deploy. Credential: KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2 (dummy for now), resolved from env; the default/existing Klaviyo key is NEVER used for this project.
spec.description: Objective: stand up email reporting for our SECOND brand (rep 1) as a read-only Klaviyo reporting pipeline, fully separate from our existing email project. This brand uses a DIFFERENT Klaviyo account than the existing email project. Credentials: the brand's Klaviyo API key is stored as KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2 (a DUMMY value for now, to be replaced with the real key before live reporting). HARD RULE: never use the default Klaviyo key for this project — all Klaviyo calls for brand2 MUST authenticate with KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2 only; if that env var is missing or still the dummy, report that plainly and do not fall back to any other key. Scope is READ-ONLY: pull campaign/flow/metric reporting from brand2's Klaviyo account (campaign performance, flow performance, open/click/revenue metrics, list/segment growth) and produce reports — no writes, no sends, no list or profile mutations in Klaviyo. Platform: operational, no software to build or deploy. Integrations: Klaviyo (brand2 account via KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2) only. Keep this brand's config and outputs isolated from the existing brand's email project so the two accounts never cross.
features: Read-only Klaviyo reporting against brand2's account using KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2 exclusively (default key explicitly forbidden)
Campaign performance report (sends, opens, clicks, open rate, click rate, revenue)
Flow performance report (per-flow and per-message metrics, conversions, revenue)
Account/metric summary (list & segment growth, deliverability/engagement trends over a chosen period)
Credential-isolation guard: fail loudly if KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2 is absent or still the dummy; never fall back to the existing/default Klaviyo key
Report output in a brand2-scoped location kept separate from the existing email project
